snippet.title: STRANGER THAN HEAVEN | Tupac & Cast Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
STRANGER THAN HEAVEN is a fifty-year, action-adventure saga of men with nowhere to go and their desperate struggle to find a home. Use extreme violence to survive, and musical talent to thrive as a showman across five cities and eras of modern Japan. Coming January 15, 2027.

PRE-ORDER or WISHLIST
